description: Get a single dashboard's full spec: title, description, source, date range, sections, widgets, and the current `revision` (pass that revision back to update_dashboard). Saved viewer settings, including settings.profiles groups (fieldId, label, imageShape, and entries with id, name, description, link, imageKey, and a signed imageUrl preview that is ignored if sent back), are included when the server returns them.
